text: Evidence 2026-08-03: implemented stable BasisElementId/BasisRole inference and validation in modules/hrf/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/hrf/Basis.scala, Hrf.scala, and HrfDescriptor.scala. ResponseFunctional now supports At, WindowMean, and WindowIntegral with explicit ResponseUnits and Exact or explicit Trapezoid discretization receipts; absent roles, malformed bases, invalid windows, non-finite weights, and unavailable exact primitives are typed failures. BasisTransform.Permutation transports coefficients and penalties, and BasisGeometrySuite covers reconstruction, role/omnibus distinction, functional units, explicit discretization, absent roles, and permutation laws. HRF gates pass 208/208 JVM, 208/208 JS, and HRF laws 77/77 JVM+JS in first-level-gate.sh. Structural response-function binding is covered by StructuralHypothesisSuite and the S10 acceptance scenario. Remaining criterion caveat: covariance transport for arbitrary basis transforms is not yet a separate artifact-level contract; keep this issue open until that evidence is added.
